title: Application of explainable ensemble artificial intelligence model to categorization of hemodialysis-patient and treatment using nationwide-real-world data in Japan.
summary: K-means plus SVM ensemble on nationwide Japanese dialysis registry data defines patient clusters and predicts one-year mortality, with separate development/validation data. Organization is unavailable in the deposited bibliographic metadata.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.ai_role: nationwide JRDR cohort split into development and validation datasets; K-means patient clusters plus SVM ensemble compared with SVM, deep learning and logistic regression. Reported validation accuracy 0.948; observational prediction, not treatment effect.
